guidance.bestFor: The plain call with no variant prop, filled with the theme primary and its foreground text

whenNotToUse.when: A label meant to sit back behind the main tag in the same row

guidance.bestFor: A lower emphasis fill from the secondary token, for metadata that sits beside a primary label

whenNotToUse.when: The strongest neutral label in a row, filled with the theme primary

guidance.bestFor: The loudest error state, a solid destructive fill with white text for failed or blocked records
A solid success fill with white text for paid, passing or live records at full emphasis
agentNotes: The solid `success` fill sets `text-white` on the installed emerald token, about 2.5:1 contrast; `success-light` keeps small text readable

whenNotToUse.when: A success message with a title and a line of detail inside the page
A paid or active state that has to pass text contrast checks

guidance.bestFor: A solid info fill with white text for neutral notices such as Beta, Syncing or Preview
A solid warning fill with white text for pending, expiring or degraded states
agentNotes: The solid `warning` fill sets `text-white` on the installed yellow token, about 1.9:1 contrast; `warning-light` keeps small text readable

whenNotToUse.when: A pending or expiring flag that must pass text contrast checks

guidance.bestFor: A neutral border around inherited text color, transparent in light mode and lightly filled in dark
A neutral border with only the label text in the primary color and no tinted fill
An error flagged by destructive foreground text alone, inside a neutral border with no tint
Info foreground text in a neutral outline, for notices that need no colored fill in dense tables
A low emphasis done or paid status, success foreground text set inside the neutral border
The quietest pending or expiring flag, warning foreground text with a neutral border and no tint

whenNotToUse.when: A pending flag that needs a tinted fill to stand out in a row

guidance.bestFor: A faint primary tint with primary text and border, softer than the solid primary fill
A pale destructive tint behind destructive text, for errors that sit in dense rows

whenNotToUse.when: An error that has to be the loudest thing in its row

guidance.bestFor: Success text on a faint success tint, a soft chip for active, paid or approved
An info tint with info text and a matching faint border, for feature or release markers
A faint warning tint behind warning text, which keeps pending or trial states readable at small sizes
The sm, default and lg sizes in one row, 18, 20 and 22px tall, to match a label to nearby text

whenNotToUse.when: Counts and tags that must read as pills in every style

guidance.bestFor: Pill counts and New tags at 3 sizes, then the pill on outline, secondary and success light

whenNotToUse.when: Labels that keep the corner radius of the active style

guidance.bestFor: An outline label led by a check glyph that the primitive sizes to 12px with no class of its own
agentNotes: An svg child with no size class of its own is forced to `size-3`, so give a larger icon its own size utility

whenNotToUse.when: A person tag with a profile photo and a remove control

guidance.bestFor: An outline tag ending in an X inside a ghost icon button shrunk to 12px, for removable filters
agentNotes: The X `Button` has no click handler and no accessible name; wire the removal and give it an aria-label such as Remove

whenNotToUse.when: A removable tag that also shows whose it is with a photo

guidance.bestFor: A 5px round dot in the current text color ahead of the label, on an info light chip for live states
agentNotes: The dot `span` is painted `currentColor`, so it follows the `variant` text color; swap that background class to color the dot alone

whenNotToUse.when: A status summary that opens on hover over a trigger

guidance.bestFor: An outline label rendered as an anchor, so the whole chip navigates and takes keyboard focus
agentNotes: The anchor goes through `render` on the base twin and `asChild` on the radix twin; replace the `href` placeholder with your route

guidance.bestFor: A person chip with a 14px avatar photo, a first name and a trailing remove X in one outline label
agentNotes: Replace the sample Unsplash `AvatarImage`, the AL `AvatarFallback` and the name Alex with the real user
The remove `Button` has no handler or accessible name, so wire the removal and label it with the person's name

whenNotToUse.when: A tag led by a glyph that names no person and cannot be removed

guidance.bestFor: A country chip with an 18px flag image ahead of the name, for locale, region or shipping tags
agentNotes: The flag `img` loads from flagcdn.com at runtime; host the SVG yourself or change the country code in its `src`
Set the flag `alt` to an empty string, since the USA text beside it already names the country
